Spiky, swept-back charcoal-gray hair. Sharp, narrow emerald-green eyes with a cunning expression. Apparent age is early thirties with a rugged, mature face. Broad-shouldered, muscular build. Wears a heavy leather chest-plate in dark brown over a forest-green tunic and black trousers. A wide leather belt with a silver buckle cinches the waist.
BODY COLOR: sun-kissed tan
